// The tangent plane of a surface at a point, as an origin, two spanning tangent
// vectors (the partial derivatives, generally neither unit nor orthogonal), and
// the unit normal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tangent_space)
type TangentSpace3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    TangentU: Vector3D;
    TangentV: Vector3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
}
